name: Ermina
source:
Works in "Amnea", keeps things in order. A sweet girl who combines an adult seriousness and a childlike openness to the world. Very sober about life and always sees right through it. Is genuinely concerned about others, but refrains from interfering in their lives and tries to be as inconspicuous as possible.

[From the in-game profile]
